list_child.name: ls_prod_batches
list_child.desc: Returns the full list of brew batches currently tracked in the production log. Use this when you need a complete overview of everything in progress or already packaged.

decoys.name: ls_pilot_batches
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of brew batches currently tracked in the pilot system log. Use this when you need a complete overview of the small test brews on the pilot kit.

decoys.name: ls_contract_batches
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of brew batches currently tracked in the contract brewing log. Use this when you need a complete overview of beer brewed under other brands' labels.

decoys.name: ls_lab_batches
decoys.desc: Returns the full list of brew batches currently tracked in the QC lab log. Use this when you need a complete overview of samples waiting on gravity and micro tests.

get_child.name: get_batch_rec
get_child.desc: Retrieves a single brew batch record using its unique identifier. This is the way to pull up the full detail on one batch from the production log.

decoys.name: get_batch_sheet
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single brew batch's brew sheet using its unique identifier. This is the way to pull up mash temps and gravity readings on one batch.

decoys.name: get_batch_coa
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single brew batch's lab certificate using its unique identifier. This is the way to pull up ABV and micro results on one batch.

decoys.name: get_batch_lots
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single brew batch's ingredient lots using its unique identifier. This is the way to pull up malt and hop traceability on one batch.

list_parent.name: ls_sales_accts
list_parent.desc: Returns every account the brewery currently sells or distributes to. This includes taprooms, restaurants, and retail partners on file.

decoys.name: ls_supply_accts
decoys.desc: Returns every account the brewery currently buys malt, hops, or yeast from. This includes maltsters, hop merchants, and yeast labs on file.

decoys.name: ls_lead_accts
decoys.desc: Returns every account the sales team is currently pitching to. This includes prospective bars, bottle shops, and grocers on file.

decoys.name: ls_lapsed_accts
decoys.desc: Returns every account the brewery has stopped selling to. This includes lapsed taprooms, closed venues, and dropped partners on file.

get_parent.name: get_acct_rec
get_parent.desc: Retrieves a single account record by its identifier. Use this when you already know which account you need and want its full details.

decoys.name: get_acct_terms
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single account's credit terms by its identifier. Use this when you already know which account you need and want its payment terms.

decoys.name: get_acct_kegs
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single account's keg ledger by its identifier. Use this when you already know which account you need and want its keg deposits.

decoys.name: get_acct_license
decoys.desc: Retrieves a single account's liquor license by its identifier. Use this when you already know which account you need and want its permit details.

delete_child.name: kill_batch_rec
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a brew batch record from the system, and this cannot be undone once it runs. Use this for batches that were dumped, mislabeled, or logged by mistake.

decoys.name: kill_batch_labels
decoys.desc: Permanently destroys the printed labels for a brew batch, and this cannot be undone once it runs. Use this for label runs that were misprinted, outdated, or ordered by mistake.

decoys.name: kill_batch_samples
decoys.desc: Permanently discards the retained samples of a brew batch, and this cannot be undone once it runs. Use this for library bottles that were spoiled, expired, or kept by mistake.

decoys.name: kill_batch_yeast
decoys.desc: Permanently dumps the harvested yeast from a brew batch, and this cannot be undone once it runs. Use this for yeast that was contaminated, over-pitched, or stored too long.

set_enum.name: set_batch_state
set_enum.desc: Moves a brew batch to a new production state, covering brewing, fermenting, conditioning, or packaged. This is the standard way production status gets updated as a batch moves through the cellar.

decoys.name: set_plan_state
decoys.desc: Sets the production state a brew batch should reach by its release date, covering brewing, fermenting, conditioning, or packaged. This is how planners stage the schedule before a batch moves through the cellar.

decoys.name: set_alert_state
decoys.desc: Sets the production state that pages the cellar crew for a brew batch, covering brewing, fermenting, conditioning, or packaged. This is how brewers get called in as a batch moves through the cellar.

decoys.name: set_hold_state
decoys.desc: Sets the production state at which a brew batch waits for QC sign-off, covering brewing, fermenting, conditioning, or packaged. This is how the lab gates a batch as it moves through the cellar.

set_bool.name: flag_recall
set_bool.desc: Marks a brew batch as under recall, pulling it out of normal circulation. This is used when there is a real quality or safety concern with the batch.

decoys.name: flag_infected
decoys.desc: Marks a brew batch as infected, pulling it off the tank schedule for testing. This is used when the lab finds wild yeast or bacteria in the batch.

decoys.name: flag_competition
decoys.desc: Marks a brew batch as a competition entry, setting bottles aside for judging. This is used when the head brewer enters the batch in a festival or awards.

decoys.name: flag_taproom
decoys.desc: Marks a brew batch as a taproom release, reserving it for the brewery's own bar. This is used when a small or experimental batch is poured on site.

set_ref.name: move_acct
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a brew batch from one account to another, which is useful when an order gets transferred or a distributor relationship changes. The batch keeps its full history after the move.

decoys.name: allocate_acct
decoys.desc: Allocates a brew batch's first cases to another account, which is useful when a limited release gets promised ahead of launch. The allocation holds until the release date.

decoys.name: sample_acct
decoys.desc: Ships tasting samples of a brew batch to another account, which is useful when a buyer wants to try a beer before ordering. The samples go out on the next delivery run.

decoys.name: consign_acct
decoys.desc: Consigns a brew batch to another account, which is useful when a bar agrees to pay after the kegs sell through. The kegs stay on the brewery's books until paid.

send.name: call_acct
send.desc: Places a call to the contact on file for a given account. Use this when a batch needs a direct conversation with the buyer.

decoys.name: text_acct
decoys.desc: Sends a text message to the contact on file for a given account. Use this when a batch needs a quick written heads-up for the buyer.
child_verbs: send a text to the account for {obj}

decoys.name: visit_acct
decoys.desc: Books a sales rep visit to the contact on file for a given account. Use this when a batch needs a face-to-face tasting with the buyer.
child_verbs: book a rep visit to the account behind {obj}
send a rep out to the account for {obj}

decoys.name: invoice_acct
decoys.desc: Sends an invoice to the contact on file for a given account. Use this when a batch needs billing after it has been delivered.

create.name: new_batch
create.desc: Creates a new brew batch for an account, with an optional recipe and starting production state. Use this when the cellar schedules another brew for a customer order.

decoys.name: new_pilot
decoys.desc: Creates a new pilot brew for an account, with an optional recipe and starting production state. Use this when the brewhouse tests a small trial beer for a customer.

decoys.name: new_order
decoys.desc: Creates a new keg order for an account, with an optional recipe and starting production state. Use this when a customer asks for beer from an existing brew.

decoys.name: new_collab
decoys.desc: Creates a new collaboration brew for an account, with an optional recipe and starting production state. Use this when a partner venue co-designs a beer with the cellar.

list_notes.name: ls_batch_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the cellar notes attached to one brew batch. Use this to read what the brewers have logged about that batch so far.

decoys.name: ls_batch_readings
decoys.desc: Returns the gravity readings attached to one brew batch. Use this to read how fermentation has progressed on that batch so far.

decoys.name: ls_batch_tastings
decoys.desc: Returns the tasting panel scores attached to one brew batch. Use this to read what the sensory panel has said about that batch so far.

decoys.name: ls_batch_additions
decoys.desc: Returns the hop and adjunct additions attached to one brew batch. Use this to read what the brewers have added to that batch so far.

add_note.name: add_batch_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new cellar note to a brew batch, with an optional title. Use this to record an observation from the brewhouse or the tanks.

decoys.name: add_batch_reading
decoys.desc: Logs a new gravity reading against a brew batch, with an optional title. Use this to record a hydrometer or refractometer result from the tanks.

decoys.name: add_batch_tasting
decoys.desc: Logs a new tasting panel score against a brew batch, with an optional title. Use this to record sensory feedback from the quality team.

decoys.name: add_batch_addition
decoys.desc: Logs a new hop or adjunct addition to a brew batch, with an optional title. Use this to record what went into the tank and when.

update_note.name: edit_batch_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing cellar note on a brew batch. Use this to correct or expand an observation after it was logged.

decoys.name: reply_batch_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing cellar note on a brew batch. Use this to answer an observation after a colleague logged it.

decoys.name: sign_batch_note
decoys.desc: Countersigns an existing cellar note on a brew batch with a comment and an optional title. Use this when the head brewer confirms an observation.

decoys.name: escalate_batch_note
decoys.desc: Escalates an existing cellar note on a brew batch to the QC lab, with a comment and an optional title. Use this when an observation needs a lab test.

delete_note.name: rm_batch_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently deletes a cellar note from a brew batch. Once removed, the note cannot be recovered from the log.

decoys.name: redact_batch_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a cellar note on a brew batch. Once redacted, the text cannot be recovered from the log.

decoys.name: purge_batch_thread
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes a cellar note and all its replies from a brew batch. Once purged, the thread cannot be recovered from the log.

decoys.name: void_batch_reading
decoys.desc: Permanently voids a gravity reading logged on a brew batch. Once voided, the reading cannot be recovered from the log.

set_image.name: set_batch_img
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a brew batch record. This is typically a photo of the beer in the glass taken by cellar staff.

decoys.name: set_batch_label
decoys.desc: Sets the label artwork shown on a brew batch record. This is typically the can wrap or bottle label signed off by the designer.

decoys.name: set_batch_tap
decoys.desc: Sets the tap handle graphic shown on a brew batch record. This is typically the badge art that goes on a bar's tap handle.

decoys.name: set_batch_micro
decoys.desc: Sets the microscope slide photo shown on a brew batch record. This is typically the yeast cell count image taken by the lab.

writer.name: write_msg
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the brew batches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_tasting
decoys.desc: Writes a short tasting note from a brief, which states the flavours in the brewer's own words, and the brew batches it should describe. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_label
decoys.desc: Writes a short label blurb from a brief, which states the story in the requester's own words, and the brew batches it should feature. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: write_taplist
decoys.desc: Writes a short tap list entry from a brief, which states the pitch in the requester's own words, and the brew batches it should list. It returns the finished text.

image.name: gen_img
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: find_img
decoys.desc: Finds a stock image matching a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: gen_video
decoys.desc: Generates a short video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the clip.

decoys.name: gen_mockup
decoys.desc: Generates a can mockup from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the render.

search.name: search_docs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how the production system works.

decoys.name: search_recipes
decoys.desc: Searches the recipe book and brew archive with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how a past beer was brewed.

decoys.name: search_regs
decoys.desc: Searches the TTB rules and labeling regulations with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up what a label must say.

decoys.name: search_sops
decoys.desc: Searches the cellar SOPs and cleaning manuals with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how a tank should be cleaned.
